test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was deported for subversion in 1907, without trial, to Mandalay in Burma?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Lala Lajpat Rai__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai (1865-1928, Punjab)**

 
 
• He was an **Extremist** leader of the Congress.
 
• He was the founder of the **National School** at **Lahore**.
 
• He was also known as **Sher-e-Punjab**.
 
• For his political agitation, he was **deported to Mandalay, Burma**, without trial in **1907**.
 
• He founded **Swaraj Party** with **Motilal Nehru** and **C.R. Das**.
 
• In the protest against **Simon Commission (1928)**, he was severely injured in the lathi charge and subsequently died.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak (1859-1920, Maharashtra)**

 
 
• He was a Congress leader from the **Extremist** faction also known as **'Lokmanya'** due to his popularity among the masses.
 
• He started the **Deccan Education Society** and established **Fergusson College**.
 
• He organized **Ganpati** and **Shivaji festivals** to create a feeling of nationalism among the masses.
 
• He started the **Home Rule movement** with **Annie besant** in **1916**.
 
• He published two newspapers, **Kesari** in **Marathi** and **Mahratta** in **English**.
 
• **Gita Rahasya, The Orion and The Arctic Home in the Vedas** are books written by him.
 
 
 
• **Mahadev Govind Ranade (1842-1901, Maharashtra)** 
 
 
• M G Ranade was a Congress leader from the **Moderate** faction.
 
• He joined **Prarthana Samaj** in **1870**.
 
• He founded **Poona Sarvajanik Sabha** in **Poona** in **1870**.
 
• He was the editor of the newspaper **Indu Prakash.**
 
 
 
• **Bipin Pal (1858-1932, Calcutta)**
 
 
• He was a Congress leader from the **Extremist** faction.
 
• He was one among the trio of **Lal-Bal-Pal**.
 
• He started the weekly newspaper **'Paridarshak'** and **'New India'**.
